services.name: Basic tune-up
services.turnaround: same day if dropped off before noon
services.includes: brake and gear adjustment, tyre pressure, chain lube, bolt check

services.name: Full tune-up
services.includes: everything in the basic tune-up plus drivetrain deep clean, wheel truing, cable check and headset service

services.name: Flat tyre repair
services.includes: tube patch or replacement tube, tyre check; a new tube adds 6 dollars

services.name: Brake pad replacement
services.includes: labour per wheel; pads are extra, 12 dollars per pair for standard rim or disc pads

services.name: E-bike service
services.includes: full tune-up plus motor and battery diagnostics; we service Bosch and Shimano motors only

policies: Bookings are free to cancel up to 24 hours before the drop-off slot.
We do not repair carbon frames or suspension forks; we can recommend a specialist.
Unclaimed bikes are stored free for 14 days, then 5 dollars per day.
Booking works by phone (555-0142) or at the counter. Nothing can be booked through this chat; the assistant can only suggest open slots.
